summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed. Related suites (test_regions, test_client, test_endpoint, test_session) show 472 passed and 1 failure, test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component, which also fails with my changes stashed, so it predates this work.
